title: Plastic bottles can be turned into edible, vanilla-flavour cookies | New Scientist
description: Hundreds of millions of tonnes of plastic pollution are created each year. One option may be to turn the pollution into food, but critics voice concerns
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: 'Off the charts' El Niño is already the strongest since records began | New Scientist
description: Renowned climate scientist James Hansen says the developing super El Niño has already "blown past" previous events with months to go before it peaks
author: Michael Le Page

title: Greenland meltwater is intensifying European heatwaves | New Scientist
description: The cooling of the North Atlantic is creating waviness in the jet stream and high-pressure ridging over Europe, a study finds
author: Alec Luhn

title: Burns improve more rapidly after treatment with fish skin | New Scientist
description: Severe burns are often treated with synthetic products ahead of skin graft surgery, but there is evidence that a product made from minimally processed cod skin is more effective
author: Alexandra Thompson

title: Super El Niño could lead to mega CO2 emissions from fires in Indonesia | New Scientist
description: Intense fires are already burning in Indonesia, and there could be much worse to come as the Super El Niño ramps up
author: Michael Le Page

title: Strange gamma-ray signal could be most direct evidence of dark matter yet | New Scientist
description: Researchers spotted an unusual gamma-ray signal in three galaxy clusters, which may be a telltale sign of dark matter – or some even more exotic phenomenon
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan
